title: FFI Boundary Lifetime and CString Hazards
platform_conditions: Any Rust toolchain linking C via extern "C" (libc on Unix, MSVC CRT on Windows); #[repr(C)] layout rules apply per target ABI
security_mechanism: CString::new(s).unwrap().as_ptr() evaluates as a temporary: the CString owning the NUL-terminated buffer is dropped at the end of the statement, so the pointer handed to the C function already points to memory that Rust has freed — the callee reads freed heap whose contents the allocator may have reused. Box::from_raw on a pointer that is not exactly the one from Box::into_raw (or called twice for one allocation) makes the allocator free a block from a mismatched base or twice. A #[repr(Rust)] struct passed across FFI as #[repr(C)] implies a field order and padding the C side does not match, so both sides read each other's fields at wrong offsets; and a Rust panic unwinding through an extern "C" frame is undefined behavior on targets where C cannot handle unwinding (panic=abort changes this).

source_sink_clues.source: Strings, buffers, and handles crossing into C: peer-supplied strings converted for C APIs, handles returned by C and re-wrapped with from_raw, struct layouts matched to C headers.
source_sink_clues.sink: CString/CStr::as_ptr results used after the owner dropped; Box::from_raw / Vec::from_raw_parts on pointers whose allocation method or count mismatches; extern "C" function signatures with non-repr(C) struct parameters

tracking_guards: Check that the CString binding outlives the call (named binding kept alive across the extern call), that every from_raw pairs exactly with the matching into_raw from the same type and runs once, that struct types crossing FFI carry #[repr(C)] matching the C header, and that panic strategy (abort vs unwind) is set deliberately for FFI-facing code with catch_unwind where needed.
not_candidate_when: The owner binding is kept alive for the whole extern call, the from_raw/into_raw pair is uniquely matched and single-shot, both sides compile the same #[repr(C)] layout from one source of truth, or the FFI surface is compile-time constant with no peer-controlled strings or counts.
